title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER QIRA NE QENDER RR. BARRIKADAVE
description_sq:
Jepet me qira apartament 2+1+2 tualete, prane zones se Qendres, tek Galeria 17-Nentori.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 9 te nje objekti te ri, te mire-administruar, me ashensor dhe me vendndodhje prane rruges kryesore.
Organizimi i apartamentit perbehet nga nje sallon dhe kuzhina e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Apartamenti ofrohet i mobiluar si ne foto dhe eshte i disponueshem per tu vizituar nga afer.
Per cdo informacion shtese, ju lutem me kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR RENT IN THE CENTER RR. barricade
description_en: 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for rent, near the Center area, at Galeria 17-Nentori. The apartment is located on the 9th floor of a new, well-managed building, with an elevator and located near the main road. The arrangement of the apartment consists of a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is offered furnished as in the photo and is available to visit up close. For any additional information, please contact me!
